annotations.text:
The Desk — three directions for the same screen (The Envelope).

Same data in all three so they compare honestly. Pick a direction, then I build it in Vue + TypeScript.

All three use the village's existing palette so the console feels native, not bolted on.

A · TERMINAL
Maximum density, keyboard-first. Queue on the left, full draft on the right, decide without lifting your hands.

Best for: speed once you know the system.
Cost: least warm, most to learn.

B · DOSSIER
Reading-first. Serif, generous measure, the draft treated as prose worth reading.

Best for: actually reading what the staff wrote — notes, memory, reasoning.
Cost: fewer things visible at once.

C · DECK
Cards and meters, with the village demoted to an ambient panel.

Best for: glanceable state, and it keeps the map alive.
Cost: less room for long text; more chrome per item.
